summary: WebRender has been refined to reduce unnecessary GPU uploads, improve pixel alignment and anti-aliasing, and handle gradients, shadows, clipping, and video overlays more reliably. A major internal update gives the renderer clearer, backend-independent GPU controls instead of relying directly on OpenGL, while debugger and Wrench tools gain better scene inspection, shader editing, and performance testing. Together, these changes improve rendering efficiency and give developers better ways to diagnose graphics issues.
